fighters.name: Zen
fighters.author: jev-arena
fighters.tagline: One sentence. No reflexes. How far does that go?
fighters.strategy: Win the fight. Do whatever a wise, calm fighter would do in this exact moment.

fighters.name: Sniper
fighters.author: jev-arena
fighters.tagline: If you can see me, it is already too late.
fighters.strategy: I keep my distance. I want the enemy at long range where my bolts land and theirs miss, so I strafe sideways while I shoot. If the enemy gets close, I retreat before they can punch me. When the enemy stands still or is stunned, I charge a heavy shot. I recharge only from behind a pillar.

actions.retreat: Back away whenever the enemy is close.
actions.charge: Only when the enemy is standing still, stunned or far away and not shooting at me.

reflexes.when: The enemy is close to me, within about 4 meters.
The enemy is stunned or standing still, and I have line of sight.
